name: Greenfield proposal pack (LLM, operator-run)
cadence: on demand (via an operator running bin/greenfield.sh from a checkout; no cron line)

knobs.note: 0 makes every greenfield stage call no model at all: bin/claude-cost.sh refuses each run_llm BEFORE claude starts with a zero-cost row_source=refused row, and the stage's FATAL line stops the pack. Takes effect wherever the settings rows are reachable (HARNESS_SECRET exported on the Mac).
Comma/space list of the ONLY runners greenfield may reach. Every stage is runner claude, so a list without claude refuses every stage. Empty is every runner, i.e. today's behaviour.

Dollars greenfield may spend in the current UTC day. With no registered stage the day's spend is summed per calling gf-* stage (the stage bin/claude-cost.sh asks about), for rows stamped lane_id=greenfield, through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, so the cap bounds each stage's own day rather than the whole pack's.
How many of the synthesized ideas get a mockup (the MOCKUPS stage). Read as ${GF_TOP:-3}.
How many per-department IDEATE sessions run at once. Read as ${GF_CONC:-3}.
